walkthroughs.body_html: Above ~80% of max HR you enter the anaerobic zone. Energy is produced without oxygen, building lactic acid and limiting how long you can sustain it. Sprinters and HIIT athletes train here.
A 16-year-old wants the anaerobic threshold (80% max HR). Max HR = 220 − 16 = 204 bpm. Anaerobic threshold = 0.8 × 204 = 163.2 bpm. Aerobic lower bound = 0.6 × 204 = 122.4 bpm.

After exercise, measure HR immediately and again after 1 minute. The drop is the recovery rate. A bigger drop means better aerobic fitness. Trained athletes recover toward resting HR much faster than untrained.
